title: Druid's €50M Series C
markdown:
### From Idea to a Game-Changer: Our Journey with DRUID AI

At Early Game Ventures, we love a good story, and our partnership with DRUID AI is one for the books. Back in 2019, when we were raising our first fund, we approached Liviu Drăgan, the founder of DRUID, with a proposal: become an LP in our fund. Instead, Liviu had something even better—an idea that would soon become DRUID. We knew right away that this was something special, and we decided to invest in him on the spot. Fast forward to today, and DRUID has just closed a $50 million Series C funding round. What a journey it’s been!

### Backing the Vision: Why We Believed in DRUID from Day One

Founded in 2018, DRUID set out to revolutionize the way businesses interact with AI. Liviu’s vision was clear: build a platform that helps companies create, deploy, and scale conversational AI applications that seamlessly integrate with their operations. We saw the potential immediately and knew this was the kind of innovation that could change industries. That early belief has been validated as DRUID has grown into a leader in the AI space, with 60% of its revenues now coming from the U.S. market.

### Big Moves: DRUID's Global Expansion and Game-Changing Partnerships

This latest $30 million funding round, led by TQ Ventures, is just the beginning of DRUID’s global expansion. The company has already made big moves with partnerships that showcase its versatility and impact. DRUID teamed up with Dacia Romania to develop an AI-powered customer service assistant that’s making interactions smoother and more natural for users. And let’s not forget the collaboration with the Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB), where DRUID launched Q, a virtual assistant that’s making the world of finance more accessible to everyone.

### More Than Just AI: Creating Real-World Solutions

What we love about DRUID is that it’s not just about AI for the sake of AI. It’s about solving real problems for real businesses. Whether it’s making customer interactions more efficient or helping people navigate complex financial markets, DRUID’s technology is making a tangible difference. With over 200 clients and a network of more than 160 partners worldwide, DRUID is leading the way in conversational AI.

### Looking Ahead: The Future of DRUID and Our Continued Support

As DRUID continues to grow, we couldn’t be prouder of how far Liviu and his team have come. From that initial conversation in 2019 to becoming a global player in AI, DRUID’s journey has been nothing short of remarkable. And we’re not done yet! We’ll continue to support DRUID as they lead the charge in the AI revolution. Here’s to more milestones, more growth, and more success—together!
